Type: sofa
Name: Strathwood All-Weather Cashmere Wicker 2-Seater Sofa
Materials: wicker
All-weather wicker 2-seater sofa with cushions and 2 pillows for outdoor or indoor use Cashmere wicker is resin fibers with reinforced steel cores; 500-pound capacity Measures 22-1/2 inches deep by 53-1/2 inches wide by 35-1/4 inches high Seat cushion: 22-1/2 inches deep by 45 inches wide by 5 inches thick Back cushion: 43 inches wide by 19 inches tall by 4-1/2 inches thick
